description: Lynia Finance - Fineract Loan Product Definitions (3 Tiers)
notes: These products match Lynia's existing credit tiers from the scoring service.
All products use declining-balance interest and equal installments.
Accounting rule = 3 (accrual-based) for RBZ regulatory compliance.
Products are created once during initial Fineract setup via setup-fineract-products.ts.

products.name: Lynia Device Loan - Tier 1 (Entry)
products.description: Entry-level device financing for new customers with credit scores 350-499. Smaller loan amounts with standard interest rate. Suitable for basic smartphones.

products.name: Lynia Device Loan - Tier 2 (Standard)
products.description: Standard device financing for customers with established credit history and scores 500-649. Mid-range loan amounts with competitive interest rate. Suitable for mid-tier smartphones and tablets.

products.name: Lynia Device Loan - Tier 3 (Premium)
products.description: Premium device financing for high-credit customers with scores 650+. Higher loan amounts, longer terms, and reduced interest rate. Suitable for premium smartphones, laptops, and equipment.
